topic: Claude Code for non-coders: build a one-page website for your team, in plain English
post:
You can build a web page today without writing a single line of code. 🌐
Here's how, with Claude Code.

First, a secret: a simple web page is just a file. Your browser opens it like any other document. 📄

Claude Code can create that file for you. You just describe what you want, in plain English.

Try it 👇
1️⃣ Make a new, empty folder called "team-page"
2️⃣ Open Claude Code and point it at that folder
3️⃣ Paste the prompt below
4️⃣ Approve when it asks to create the file
5️⃣ Double-click the file to open it in your browser

Copy this prompt:
"Create a single web page file called index.html for my team. Add a welcome message, a list of our 5 weekly priorities, and a section for team birthdays. Make it clean and colorful. Use one file only, so I can open it in my browser."

Don't love it? Just say:
"Make the colors calmer and the text bigger." 🎨

📌 Claude Code is included with Claude's Pro and Max plans.

Why it matters:
Once you see your words turn into a real page, "I'm not technical" stops being a reason not to try. 💡

What would you put on your first web page? 👇

Follow me: I'm teaching one Claude skill a day, no tech background needed.
